issues: Golfer's posture and orientation could suggest either handedness, but does not forcefully indicate left-handedness.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Ensure the golfer's body position, orientation, and hand use clearly indicate a left-handed player—for example, show the right hand placing the ball with the left side of the body towards the intended play direction. All other details are accurate.

questions.title: What Happens If You Put the Ball Down Instead of Dropping It?
questions.question: If the rules say you must drop your ball, but you put it on the ground with your hand instead, what happens?
questions.explanation: If you put the ball on the ground when you should have dropped it, and then play your shot, you get 2 extra shots added to your score.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: Letting the ball fall from your hand from knee height.
An extra shot added to your score for breaking a rule.

questions.teachingTip: Practise dropping the ball from knee height so you remember not to place it. You can use a toy or a small ball to make it fun.
likelyMisconceptions: Some players think placing and dropping are the same, but in golf, they are different.
Players might forget to drop from the right height or use their hand instead of letting it fall.

questions.title: Penalty for Placing Instead of Dropping
questions.question: If the rules require you to drop your ball, but you place it instead, what is the penalty?
questions.explanation: Placing the ball when you are supposed to drop it, and then playing from there, results in a two-stroke penalty.
